UNDERSTANDING CELL DIVISION
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what understanding cell division means in plain words.
• Give one clear example linked to Cell division.
• Correct one common mistake about this page.

INTRODUCTION
----
Understanding Cell division. Get clear on cell division before moving on. How would you explain cell division to a classmate in one minute? Use this anchor: Describe the process of cell division in living organisms,. Clue from the topic: Describe the process of cell. Check every example on this page against that anchor.

MAIN NOTES
----
• The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of living organisms.
• Plant cells have a cell wall and usually chloroplasts; animal cells do not.
• Diffusion is net movement of particles from high to low concentration; osmosis is water through a selectively permeable membrane.
• Magnification = eyepiece power × objective power — multiply, never add.
• Use correct biology words: membrane, nucleus, cytoplasm, vacuole, chloroplast.
